name: upli_credit_bank
description: Single-channel native UPLI sender credit bank; Common 2.0 2.6/4.3; bounded contract in docs/upli_credit_rtl_plan.md.

design_requirements.confirmation_notes: User authorized independent full UALink implementation with local Verilator/Yosys/OpenSTA. Agent derives this local internal module contract from the audited model; port spelling and atomic diagnostic hold are implementation choices, not separately approved normative wire fields.

behavior: Per-port VC0..3 plus one cross-VC pool.
Returns encode one through four and do not follow TDM slots.
Consume only prior credit and confirmed initialization; no same-edge bypass.
Net update and bounded capacity; invalid edge holds all state and registers a local diagnostic.
Initialization confirms after a parameterized consecutive burst greater than one; then sticky.
constraints: One register per synchronous always block; single clock domain and no raw gated clocks.
Native UPLI, snake_case module naming and semantic Chinese same-line comments.
Local diagnostic does not retract wire traffic or implement protocol RAS.
notes: Port-width metadata uses default one-port width-four elaboration because the artifact schema requires an integer; real o_balances width is C_NUM_PORTS*5*C_CREDIT_WIDTH and is tested parametrically.
Explicit local user toolchain overrides skill remote/simulator defaults.
Whole skill selfcheck currently lacks companion manage_docs.py; separate from project EDA.
